The '''Droid Assassin's rifle''' was a heavily modified [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifle]] that was primarily used by the [[HK-series assassin droid|HK-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. Some of the modifications of this weapon included improved optics, reduced recoil, extended range, and several open ports for even more modular upgrades.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', only [[HK-47]] can equip this weapon.
